venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: They run Baugh. Faulkner dresses the first drive so you cannot sit on that. White moves Woods. The hitch is the tax.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — first drives sat with Charles. Later snaps are official result, not a second film sit. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Baugh is the night. The opening script is how Faulkner keeps them from sitting on him. Pistol was one look. It is not the offense.

offense.body:
They run Baugh. That is the offense. 160 yards. Three rushing scores. The 61 when the whole stadium knows. Faulkner’s job is to keep you from sitting on that.

The opening drive is the variety. Two tight ends. H-back off the line. Read. Give. Baugh, 9. Same family, the line washes right, Baugh cuts left, 8. Then Brown in motion, pullers sell counter, interior out for the screen, dump to the motion man. Then pistol, an H-back, three wide — run on second-and-2, same set, Wilson sits, 19. Then motion one way, tackles the other, the end crashes, Philo keeps it, Sledge is still there. Pistol is in that script. It is not the team.

The rest of the night is still Baugh, then the other answers.

Short field after the 18-yard punt. Baugh left, 18. Stockton, catch at the 11, he walks in.

They stall. Brown takes it himself, 14. Durkin from 53.

After FAU scores, Abrams down the sideline, 63. They crowded the run. He threw it over the top. The snap loses twenty inside the five. Baugh still gets 25 back on third-and-28. Philo, 3, fourth-and-3, they stay on the field.

Wilson again, 15. Two misses. Sneak on fourth-and-1. Harpring in the middle, 19. Baugh, 12, punch.

Johnson’s pick. Clark, 15 and 7. Baugh, 7, punch.

Second half. Stockton, 8, to set up third-and-2. Baugh left, 61. Baugh, 6, punch.

Wilson, 13. Brown, 33. Brown again, 18, on third-and-11. Clark in the route, 10, touchdown.

Clark, 28, to the 6. Clark, 4, punch. Then Jones Jr., Louis, Amir, Micah Jones. Same idea with the next group — run it, then get somebody out in space.

Brown is not a one-snap gadget. Screen on the opening drive. The 49 when the corner is off. The 14 as the runner. The 33 and the 18 later. Wilson is the chain mover all night — 19, 15, 13 — not one sit. Stockton scores from 12 and moves it before the 61. Abrams is the shot. Harpring is the middle. Clark runs it and catches it.

What to clean: the keep Sledge won. The snap that loses twenty. The ball that comes off Mays. Those are real. They are not the night. The night is Baugh, and Faulkner will not let you sit on him.
bullets: Baugh is the offense. 160, three rushing scores, the 61.
The opening drive is the variety — read, screen, pistol, keep — so you cannot sit on the run. Pistol is one look in that script.
The rest of the night: Stockton from 12, Brown as the runner and the 49, Abrams 63, Wilson the chains, Harpring, Clark both ways, they stay on fourth down.
Clean the Sledge keep, the snap, and the ball off Mays.

defense.body:
White mixes the odd front. Woods is the lever.

He will play a 3-3-5. Three down. JACK as a stand-up. Two linebackers. Five DBs. Then he will space the tackles, stand both edges up, and run a stunt. Then he will shade three down linemen to one side and put Woods and a linebacker in the other gap. He changes the look often enough that the line cannot get a clean count. Not every snap. Often.

On third down he moves Woods. On the ball, Woods is the edge. Off the ball, the edge belongs to somebody else and Woods is coming or dropping from a different spot. That is how you put the rusher in a better lane without telling the tackle who has him. Third-and-7: Woods in a backer, press, comeback to Henry, they convert. Third-and-1: Woods off, nickel on the line, corners off, hitch to Valsin, they convert. Later Woods is in the run fit — Ervin, Farrow — when they try to stay on schedule.

The coverage mixes with the front. Early down: one-high, corners off, Chiles fills the short middle, three yards, they win the snap. Next snap: same family, wide stunt, Valsin converts — the hitch is the tax. Third-and-10: shade front, press one side, off the other. Coleman opens to the middle, sells the hole, the ball goes outside, Coleman is already back to the receiver. That is the pick. Not a blitz they needed. He moved the quarterback’s eyes. Johnson’s pick is the same family.

FAU lived on the hitch, the comeback, and the sit — five to eight yards at a time. White plays off a lot. When the stunt does not get home, that throw is there. That is ninety snaps.

What looked good: Coleman’s bait. Johnson’s pick. Bett stripping the keep at the 1. McCloud taking fourth-and-2. James stopping Ervin to end the half. Chiles on the short middle. Lyons and Flowers in the backfield. Woods when he is asked to tackle.

What leaked: Henry and Valsin taking what was given. The pile at the 1. The edge leaving and Veltkamp walking in. The fade when the corner is off. Hoch on fourth down. Sit on the hitch. Keep the edge when the quarterback keeps it.
bullets: 3-3-5, spaced, shaded — he mixes the odd front. Woods is the lever on third down.
Coleman sells middle, takes outside. Johnson’s pick is the same family.
They play off a lot. The hitch is the tax. Ninety snaps.
Clean the pile, the edge, the fade, Hoch on fourth. Sit on the hitch.

specials.body: The drive stalls. They take the points. Durkin from 53. Florida never punts. FAU’s 18-yard punt is how the second Florida score starts.
bullets: FAU’s 18-yard punt sets up the short field.

keys: Baugh is the night. Faulkner dresses the first drive so you cannot sit on him.
Pistol was one look in the opening script. It is not the offense.
White mixes the 3-3-5. Woods is the lever on third down. Not every snap. Often.
FAU’s night is the hitch until somebody sits on it.

nextWeek.look: They will throw it short and keep it. Florida will still run Baugh and dress the picture. White has to sit on the hitch and keep Woods’ edge home when the quarterback pulls it.
